actual: Historical replay blocks on 2026-06-16 because market.daily_basic turnover_rate_f/free_share contain PostgreSQL numeric NaN for almost all instruments. The existing targeted backfill script counts only SQL NULL as missing and its COALESCE upsert cannot replace numeric NaN, so safe recovery is impossible. The canonical daily_basic ingestion script also passes provider non-finite numeric values directly to PostgreSQL, allowing the defect to recur. Add finite-value normalization, preview, atomic replacement and regression coverage; validate only against local 127.0.0.1/aistock DEV before resuming replay.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

expected: Dry-run and atomic apply must treat SQL NULL, PostgreSQL numeric NaN, and non-finite provider values explicitly so a finite Tushare snapshot can safely repair only invalid target cells. Canonical daily_basic ingestion must normalize provider NaN and +/-Infinity to SQL NULL and must not erase an existing finite target value with an invalid provider value.
